run_dynamics_simulation: run the dynamics simulation with hydra config to simulate gradient descent on complex matrices A, B, C
compute_grad: compute the exact gradient of loss with respect to complex matrices A, B, C using circular convolutions
compute_approx_grad: compute the approximate gradient of loss with respect to complex matrices A, B, C without circular convolution terms
perfect_memorization_init: create a perfect memorization initialization of complex matrices A, B, C using roots of unity
find_optimal_delta: find the optimal perturbation direction that maximizes gradient deviation for matrices A, B, C
